item.title: Trouble on the Right – Why Conservatives Need to be Wary - MageeNews.com
item.description: I only recently learned what a “groyper” is - you may or may not be familiar with the term? From what I can tell, a groyper is a hardline white nationalist. Often anti-Semitic, groypers are hostile to mainstream conservatives. To the extent they have a coherent agenda, groypers seem more national socialism than free-market capitalism.
